statement: Each motor's 37 mm lead reaches its socket on the flight controller with at least 3 mm to spare
rationale: The lead runs straight from the motor's base to its plug in the ESC socket under the board's side arm on that motor's side (model/assembly.py motor_lead_route); the topology problem keeps that run clear of the frame. A lead pulled taut pulls its plug out in the first crash; 3 mm is a small slack loop. Lead length is the listing's 37 mm (no soldering: the lead cannot be extended).

mechanism.how: each lead's straight run from the motor's base to its plug under the board, against its 37 mm
